headline: Proposed changes to the Inclusionary Zoning Ordinance, plus a federal housing funding public engagement plan and a tax increment financing report.
summary: Items include proposed changes to inclusionary zoning rules, a public engagement plan for federal housing grant funds, and two annual reports. Public comment will be taken before action on each item.
items: Public comment and recommendation to City Council on the Citizen Participation Plan for the 2027-2031 HUD Consolidated Plan
Public comment and discussion of proposed Inclusionary Zoning Ordinance policy amendments, to guide staff drafting and a later Planning Board recommendation
Public comment and recommendation to forward the FYE2026 Tax Increment Financing Annual Report to City Council as a communication item
Public comment and recommendation to forward the 2026 Annual Accomplishment Report to City Council as a communication item

Housing & Economic 
Development Committee Meeting

To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email edd@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions must be 
received by 12:00 pm the day before the Housing & Economic Development meeting to guarantee their 
inclusion in the agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help 
ensure your comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
REMOTE ACCESS INFORMATION 
 
The Housing & Economic Development Committee will conduct this meeting remotely via Zoom pursuant to 
the Remote Meeting Policy adopted by the Portland City Council. Allow your computer to install the free Zoom 
app to get the best meeting experience. If you are not able to attend a recording will be available in the Agenda 
Center following the meeting. 
 
For public comment via Zoom, you will need to use the "raise your hand" feature. To raise your hand via the 
telephone, please hit *9. You will be unmuted by the host when it is time for public comment. 
 
https://portlandmaine-gov.zoom.us/j/83329598115?pwd=QnfQQHnN8dDEDPPXS55htOhMV8zKPz.1 
 
1. Review and accept Minutes of previous meeting held on October 20, 2026  
     
  a. See attached draft Minutes. 
      
2. 
Public Comment - Review and recommendation to City Council of the Citizen 
Participation Plan for the 2027-2031 HUD Consolidated Plan - Mary Davis, Housing 
and Community Development (HCD) Division Director 
 
  
This action item introduces proposed updates to the Citizen Participation Plan for the 
2027-2031 HUD Consolidated Plan for review and recommendation to the City Council. 
The plan governs public engagement for allocating Federal CDBG, HOME, and ESG grant 
funds, directly aligning with City Council goals to accelerate housing production, reduce 
chronic homelessness, and strengthen economic vitality. This presentation serves as the 
initial review of the updated framework. Adopting the plan extends community engagement 
activities and redefines substantial amendment thresholds for greater administrative 
flexibility, carrying no direct fiscal impact on the City while maintaining eligibility for 
Federal funding. Public comment will be taken prior to Committee action.  
  
  a. See attached Memorandum 
      
  b. See attached Citizen Participation Plan 
      
  c. See attached eCFR 24 CFR 91.105 Citizen Participation Plan 
      
3. Public Comment - Review and discuss the Committee's proposed policy amendments 
to the Inclusionary Zoning Ordinance for guidance to staff to draft and bring back to
2 
this Committee for its review and recommendation to the Planning Board - Chair 
Councilor Pious Ali 
  
This is the last of three meetings the HEDC has scheduled for Calendar Year 2026 to 
consider possible IZ policy changes to recommend to the Planning Board. The prior 
discussions were held on October 6 and October 20, 2026. “Considering adjustments to the 
IZ ordinance to promote housing production” was identified in the 2026 Council Common 
Goals as a way to accelerate housing production and strengthen affordability protections. 
Public comment will be taken prior to Committee action. 
  
  a. See attached staff Memorandum. 
      
  b. See attached IZ Study Presented at the 2/17/2026 HEDC Meeting 
      
  c. See attached City Councilors' suggested policy amendments. 
      
4. 
Public Comment - Review and recommendation to the City Council to forward the 
FYE2026 Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Annual Report to the City Council as a 
communication item - Patricia Finnigan, Interim Housing and Economic Development 
Director 
 
  
The City of Portland TIF Policy requires an Annual TIF District Activity Report to be 
provided to the City Council. HEDC is asked to review and recommend the report 
highlighting activity during FY2026 to the City Council as a communication item. Public 
comment will be taken prior to Committee action.  
  
  a. See attached staff Memorandum. 
      
  b. See attached FYE2026 TIF Report 
      
5. 
Public Comment - Review and recommendation to the City Council to forward the 
Housing and Economic Development Committee’s 2026 Annual Accomplishment 
Report as a communication item - Patricia Finnigan, Interim Housing and Economic 
Development Director 
 
  
HEDC will be presented with a summary of Committee accomplishments for the calendar 
year 2026 that represent the Committee Work Plan and alignment with the 2026 City 
Council Goals. If approved, the report will go to the City Council as a communication. 
Public comment will be taken prior to Committee action.  
  
  a. See attached staff Memorandum. 
      
  b. See attached 2026 Work Plan 
      
 
 
Next Meeting Date: January 19, 2027
